p.s: Nowadays, we find both specialists and people of general knowledge in all kinds of matters.

Also, when it comes to finding employement, broad knowledge shows our employer that we are able to interest ourselves in any situation and that they are all worth paying attention to.
Moreover, this knowledge helps us understand how our modern society has come to what is is today and how it functions.
We do so by linking differents subjects and without which, the understanding of it 's mecanisms would not be possible and within pour reach.
On the other hand, the knowledge of many academic subjects makes us less effective in certain areas of work that require as well as general knowledge, specific mecanisms.
